sentences.en: It's like whatever Andy's feeling, I don't I didn't feel like his brother was trying to stir the pot, you know, totally.
sentences.zh: 感觉无论安迪有什么情绪，我都不觉得他弟弟是在故意挑拨离间，完全没有。

sentences.en: I think that a lot of it is, you know, is is within Andy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很大程度上，你知道，这都是安迪自己的问题。

sentences.en: There's there's a lot of there's a lot of stuff that Andy's kind of like, you know, needs therapy about.
sentences.zh: 安迪身上有很多……有很多东西是需要接受心理治疗的。

sentences.en: But it's it's and that's that can happen.
sentences.zh: 但这……这确实会发生。

sentences.en: And maybe at some point there was a little bit of that rub.
sentences.zh: 也许在某个时刻，他们之间确实有过一点摩擦。

sentences.en: But I think that now it's like everybody's grown up.
sentences.zh: 但我认为现在大家都长大了。

sentences.en: And I think that truly I felt one of the things I loved about Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 而且我真心觉得，关于小沃尔特，我最喜欢的一点是……

sentences.en: Is that like he's like this super talented golden retriever that just like doesn't know.
sentences.zh: 他就像一只超级有天赋的金毛寻回犬，只是他自己不知道。

sentences.en: He's like, oh, yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 他就像是，哦，好的，没问题。

sentences.en: I'll go fetch that acoustic guitar and, you know, sing this sing this beautiful angelic song for all of you.
sentences.zh: 我去把那把木吉他拿来，然后为你们所有人唱这首……这首美妙的天使般的歌。

sentences.en: And Andy is just eating him up inside, you know, and yeah,
sentences.zh: 而安迪在内心深处对他嫉妒得要命，你知道，是的。

sentences.en: I think that that kind of lack of awareness was one of the things that really made that dynamic really adorable and really fun.
sentences.zh: 我认为那种缺乏自觉的状态，正是让那种互动变得非常可爱和有趣的原因之一。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think I think the parents knew better a little bit, but I don't think Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我觉得父母多少是知道一点的，但我不觉得小沃尔特

sentences.en: knew better.
sentences.zh: 知道。

sentences.en: I think Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 我觉得小沃尔特

sentences.en: is just just, you know, living his dream.
sentences.zh: 只是……你知道，活在他自己的梦想里。

sentences.en: And it's like there's always those people out there that just have that little extra serotonin that you're just like, how that must be nice.
sentences.zh: 就像总有那么一些人，他们天生就比别人多那么一点血清素，让你觉得，哇，那一定很不错。

sentences.en: How do you, how do you, God, if I could live in that brain for just one day, you know, that would be really, really fun.
sentences.zh: 你怎么……你怎么……天哪，如果我能在那样的脑子里住上一天，你知道，那一定会非常、非常有意思。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，你知道，小沃尔特

sentences.en: is one of those people where it's just like he keeps falling up.
sentences.zh: 就是那种总是能顺风顺水的人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And Andy's just had to be kind of next to that, you know, at all times.
sentences.zh: 而安迪不得不一直待在他身边，你知道，随时随地。

sentences.en: And a side note to that, which is really funny because now I'm doing Sweeney Todd is that, you know,
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，这真的很有趣，因为我现在正在演《理发师陶德》，你知道，

sentences.en: one of my other very favorite episodes of The Office is the Sweeney Todd episode.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的《办公室》剧集之一就是《理发师陶德》那一集。

sentences.en: And it's one that we all kind of quote and and love very much backstage at our Sweeney Todd is that, of course, Andy, you know, is in Sweeney Todd.
sentences.zh: 那是我们在《理发师陶德》后台经常引用并且非常喜欢的一集，当然，安迪在《理发师陶德》里演的是……

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And is Antony in Sweeney Todd.
sentences.zh: 安东尼在《理发师陶德》里。

sentences.en: And now you're in Sweeney Todd, but you're the lead.
sentences.zh: 现在你也在演《理发师陶德》，但你是主角。

sentences.en: And you're on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 而且你是在百老汇演出。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So you have bested him again.
sentences.zh: 所以你又一次胜过他了。

sentences.en: I have bested him yet again.
sentences.zh: 我又一次胜过他了。

sentences.en: And that is the universe being so weird and so wonderful.
sentences.zh: 这就是宇宙的神奇与美妙之处。

sentences.en: And so, yes, yeah, it's it's great.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这太棒了。

sentences.en: But and I'm I'm hoping at some point Ed and I can really kind of sit down and have a proper talk and hug it out.
sentences.zh: 但我希望在某个时候，我和艾德能真正坐下来，好好谈谈，然后拥抱和解。

sentences.en: That would be awesome.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: When you were on set, Josh, did you ever break in a scene?
sentences.zh: 乔什，你在片场的时候，演戏时笑场过吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，有啊。

sentences.en: All the time.
sentences.zh: 经常。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 哦，有，绝对有。

sentences.en: I guess one of my questions for you, because I was only I did two episodes and spent a day doing each episode.
sentences.zh: 我有个问题想问你们，因为我当时只拍了两集，每集花了一天时间。

sentences.en: But I kind of wanted to ask you guys as well, you know, was that was there always room for improv on your days?
sentences.zh: 但我其实也想问问你们，你们在片场的时候，是不是总有即兴发挥的空间？

sentences.en: Because because the scripts were brilliant.
sentences.zh: 因为剧本写得太精彩了。

sentences.en: Each one, every time I read it, it was so conversational and it felt so natural.
sentences.zh: 每一集，我每次读的时候，都觉得对话感很强，非常自然。

sentences.en: And there were oftentimes things that were written that if I hadn't known it was written, I would think, oh, that must have been an improvised line.
sentences.zh: 而且经常会有一些台词，如果我不知道那是写好的，我肯定会觉得，哦，那一定是即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: And that's just that's just how wonderful it was.
sentences.zh: 剧本就是写得这么好。

sentences.en: But there was such wonderful improv happening at Shroot FarMs.
sentences.zh: 但在施鲁特农场拍摄时，确实有很多精彩的即兴发挥。

sentences.en: Everybody was just kind of pitching things and and even off camera, just so everybody's just so funny.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在出谋划策，即使在镜头外，大家也都特别幽默。

sentences.en: Kate Flannery was always finding new ways to like get me, you know, and with like the idea of like pulling my vocal cords out of my throat, you know, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 凯特·弗兰纳里总是能想出新花样来整我，你知道的，比如想把我的声带从喉咙里扯出来之类的，就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, I mean, was that always encouraged or was that something that kind of developed over time or or was that just the writing made it seem that way at all times?
sentences.zh: 所以，我想问，这种即兴发挥是一直被鼓励的，还是随着时间推移慢慢形成的，又或者只是因为剧本写得让人感觉像即兴的？

sentences.en: It was sort of all of those things.
sentences.zh: 这几种情况都有。

sentences.en: I mean, it did always start with an amazing script, but it was always a living, breathing thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，虽然总是以精彩的剧本为基础，但它始终是一个鲜活的、不断演变的东西。

sentences.en: So the writers of that episode and the producers would come down and they were always pitching alternate lines.
sentences.zh: 所以那一集的编剧和制片人会到现场，他们总是会提出备选台词。

sentences.en: Pitching.
sentences.zh: 提供建议。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they would throw them out to the actors or the actors might have an idea in the moment.
sentences.zh: 他们会把这些建议抛给演员，或者演员在拍摄时也会有自己的想法。

sentences.en: And it was always allowed.
sentences.zh: 而且这总是被允许的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, as long as we had gotten it in a scripted way, at least once.
sentences.zh: 只要我们至少按剧本演过一遍就行。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Then we could play around.
sentences.zh: 之后我们就可以自由发挥了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's really cool.
sentences.zh: 那真的很酷。

sentences.en: And also just being kind of like an outsider in the group, I had not done a lot of acting at that time.
sentences.zh: 而且作为团队里的一个外来者，我当时并没有多少表演经验。

sentences.en: And I'd certainly not done a lot of comedy acting at that time.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时肯定没怎么演过喜剧。

sentences.en: And so to be around so many very funny, very talented people, we got to like share stories about like our different worlds.
sentences.zh: 所以能和这么多非常有趣、非常有才华的人在一起，我们有机会分享彼此不同世界的故事。

sentences.en: Like, so what's touring like, you know?
sentences.zh: 比如，巡演是什么样的？

sentences.en: And so, you know, it actually kind of turned into like a real garden party, but like we just, we were, you know, just getting yogurt from craft.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的变成了一场真正的花园派对，虽然我们只是在休息区拿酸奶吃。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was just, it was just like really, really fun.
sentences.zh: 而且，真的，真的非常非常有趣。

sentences.en: Really cool.
sentences.zh: 真的很酷。

sentences.en: It was a hot day though.
sentences.zh: 不过那天天气很热。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: It was so hot that day.
sentences.zh: 那天热得要命。

sentences.en: I found an email that Jenna and I traded back and forth about how hot it was and how that they had these huge tubes of air.
sentences.zh: 我翻到了一封我和珍娜当时互发的邮件，里面提到了天气有多热，还有他们准备了那些巨大的送风管。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And we were all fighting about where you could sit.
sentences.zh: 我们都在争抢座位。

sentences.en: So the tube of air would hit you.
sentences.zh: 为了能吹到那个送风管的风。

sentences.en: And they turned them on whenever we took a break in scenes and everyone would like go around the tube, except in this email, I said, unfortunately,
sentences.zh: 每当我们休息时，他们就会打开风管，大家都围着风管转，除了在邮件里我提到的，不幸的是，

sentences.en: Ellie was sitting basically right on top of the tube.
sentences.zh: 艾莉当时基本上就坐在风管口上。

sentences.en: Like the tube kind of came right out to her chair and she was freezing.
sentences.zh: 那个风管口正好对着她的椅子，她都快冻僵了。

sentences.en: And the rest of us were like, pull the tube this way.
sentences.zh: 而我们其他人都在喊，把风管往这边挪挪。

sentences.en: We're burning up.
sentences.zh: 我们要热死了。

sentences.en: Apparently the tubes were a big deal during the shoot.
sentences.zh: 看来那些送风管在拍摄期间确实很重要。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And she, she was even peppier in those scenes.
sentences.zh: 而且她在那些戏份里表现得甚至更有活力。

sentences.en: And that's the reason, that's the reason why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因，这就是原因所在。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That's, that's so funny.
sentences.zh: 那真是，那真是太搞笑了。

sentences.en: Everybody gathering around the, the coolant tube.
sentences.zh: 大家都围在那个冷却管旁边。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was, it was very, very hot.
sentences.zh: 是啊，当时真的，真的非常非常热。

sentences.en: You said you hadn't done a lot of acting, but you had just been in crazy, stupid love with Steve Carell.
sentences.zh: 你说过你没怎么演过戏，但你刚和史蒂夫·卡瑞尔一起演了《疯狂愚蠢的爱》。

sentences.en: That's actually true.
sentences.zh: 那倒是真的。

sentences.en: Which is crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Which was like one of my first things that I ever did, you know, outside of music.
sentences.zh: 那算是我在音乐之外做的第一件事吧，你知道的。

sentences.en: And that was not a DM slide getting, Steve, Steve did not, did not.
sentences.zh: 而且那可不是私信勾搭来的，史蒂夫，史蒂夫他没有，真的没有。

sentences.en: It was proper.
sentences.zh: 那是正儿八经的试镜。

sentences.en: Did not slide into my DMs for that role.
sentences.zh: 他没有为了那个角色给我发私信。

sentences.en: I so wish that was the story behind that though.
sentences.zh: 我真希望背后的故事是那样的。

sentences.en: Can we just say that that's what it was?
sentences.zh: 我们能就这么说吗？

sentences.en: I want to rewrite history.
sentences.zh: 我想改写历史。

sentences.en: No, here's the, here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 不，事情是这样的。

sentences.en: No, it was, that was such a fun shoot as well.
sentences.zh: 不，那次拍摄真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: It was again, just a, just a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 而且又一次，只是，只是几天的时间。

sentences.en: We shot at the Glendale Galleria and we shot all night at like an El Torito.
sentences.zh: 我们在格伦代尔广场购物中心拍摄，还在一家 El Torito 餐厅拍了一整晚。

sentences.en: I know the Glendale Galleria.
sentences.zh: 我知道格伦代尔广场购物中心。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: The Glendale Galleria.
sentences.zh: 格伦代尔广场购物中心。

sentences.en: Every time I drive by it, getting onto the 101, I was like, yeah, that's, I had a lot of tortilla chips.
sentences.zh: 每次我开车经过那里，准备上 101 号公路时，我都会想，没错，我当时吃了很多玉米片。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That's where I had my first on-screen kiss.
sentences.zh: 那是我第一次银幕初吻的地方。

sentences.en: But weren't you a theater major?
sentences.zh: 但你不是戏剧专业的吗？

sentences.en: I was a theater major, but I got plucked out of college when I, when I got a recording contract.
sentences.zh: 我是戏剧专业的，但我拿到唱片合约时就被学校“挖”走了。

sentences.en: It was a weird fork in the road and one that has, you know, afforded me some extraordinary experiences like this one.
sentences.zh: 那是人生中一个奇怪的分岔路口，但也正是它，你知道的，让我获得了像这次一样非凡的经历。

sentences.en: But it was my first love was, was doing theater.
sentences.zh: 但我最初的爱，一直是戏剧表演。

sentences.en: My first, my, and my first love before that was doing comedy and doing improv.
sentences.zh: 我最初的，我在此之前的初恋是喜剧和即兴表演。

sentences.en: I was very lucky to do a lot of improv in high school and junior high school.
sentences.zh: 我很幸运，在高中和初中时做了很多即兴表演。

sentences.en: It kind of like got me out of my shell when I was really, really shy and having a hard time making friends and my grades weren't great.
sentences.zh: 它让我从那种非常非常害羞、难以交朋友、成绩也不太好的状态中走了出来。

sentences.en: And I just was like kind of trapped.
sentences.zh: 当时我感觉自己被困住了。

sentences.en: And joining like the school improv troupe and being able to be part of like a youth second city class when I was like, you know, 11.
sentences.zh: 加入学校的即兴表演剧团，并在我 11 岁时参加了青年第二城剧团的课程。

sentences.en: And, and being part of the LA Connection Comedy Theater in the Valley when I was, you know, 13 and 14.
sentences.zh: 还有在我 13、14 岁时，参加了山谷地区的 LA Connection 喜剧剧场。

sentences.en: Like those kinds of improv games were so good for that muscle in my brain that had not been activated at that point.
sentences.zh: 那些即兴游戏对我大脑中当时尚未被激活的区域非常有帮助。

sentences.en: And was so great for me being social and being able to, because improv is all about kind of saying yes and really listening and being part of that.
sentences.zh: 这对我的社交能力大有裨益，因为即兴表演的核心就是“说是”，学会倾听并融入其中。

sentences.en: And when you're closed off as a kid, those things kind of get stunted.
sentences.zh: 当你还是个孩子却封闭自己时，这些能力往往会发育迟缓。

sentences.en: And so it was finding the rhythm of comedy was something that really got me out of my shell long before finding the rhythm of, of music.
sentences.zh: 所以，在找到音乐的节奏感之前，是喜剧的节奏感让我真正走出了自我。

sentences.en: And, and then that fork in the road happened and it's been the most incredible journey of my life to be able to be a solo artist and make music and sing for people.
sentences.zh: 后来，那个分岔路口出现了，能成为一名独唱艺人，创作音乐并为人们歌唱，这是我一生中最不可思议的旅程。

sentences.en: But every time I've had an opportunity to step back into, you know, the camaraderie of, of acting and comedy and theater, it's an absolute blaSt.
sentences.zh: 但每当有机会重回表演、喜剧和戏剧那种并肩作战的氛围中时，我总是乐在其中。

sentences.en: You were speaking to my improv heart.
sentences.zh: 你真是说到我的即兴表演心坎里去了。

sentences.en: My improv heart is singing.
sentences.zh: 我的即兴表演之心在歌唱。

sentences.en: Um, I moved around a lot as a kid and one of the ways I would connect is through improv class or sketch comedy and just being an outsider.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我小时候经常搬家，而我融入环境的方式之一就是通过即兴表演课或小品喜剧，因为我总是个局外人。

sentences.en: It was a way in, um, and I actually had my kids do an improv class and it was so adorable.
sentences.zh: 这是一种切入点，嗯，我实际上让我孩子们也去上了即兴表演课，太可爱了。

sentences.en: And at the same time, the very first minute I sat there on their performance night and they came out and they started doing these improv games that I had done.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在他们表演的那晚，我坐在那里的第一分钟，当他们走出来开始做那些我曾经做过的即兴游戏时。

sentences.en: I started crying.
sentences.zh: 我开始哭了。

sentences.en: My husband was like, I don't think you should be crying.
sentences.zh: 我丈夫说，我觉得你不该哭的。

sentences.en: Like, but I was just like, I'm so moved that these same games are there and it's yes.
sentences.zh: 但我就是觉得，看到这些相同的游戏还在传承，而且那种“说是”的精神还在，我真的太感动了。

sentences.en: And, and being in the moment and listening and, and trust, you know, it's, it, there's so much trust involved in it.
sentences.zh: 还有，活在当下，学会倾听，还有信任，你知道，这其中涉及太多的信任了。

sentences.en: And the idea is nothing like it in the world.
sentences.zh: 这种理念在世界上是独一无二的。

sentences.en: The idea of going out, not knowing what's going to happen and trusting yourself and trusting the people that are around you.
sentences.zh: 那种走上台，不知道会发生什么，却依然信任自己、信任身边伙伴的理念。

sentences.en: I just recently did four or five performances of this wonderful show that was on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 我最近刚在那部百老汇精彩剧目中演了四五场。

sentences.en: It's not there anymore called Freestyle Love Supreme, which is kind of a music, it was like a music improv show that Lin-Manuel Miranda and a number of other incredible, uh,
sentences.zh: 那部剧现在已经停演了，叫《自由式爱至上》（Freestyle Love Supreme），它算是一种音乐即兴表演，是由林-曼努尔·米兰达（Lin-Manuel Miranda）和一些其他了不起的……呃，

sentences.en: freestyle rappers and musicians kind of put together.
sentences.zh: 自由式说唱歌手和音乐人共同创作的。

sentences.en: And it's, it's comedy, it's rap, it's music.
sentences.zh: 它融合了喜剧、说唱和音乐。

sentences.zh: 他上了车，然后加速离开了。

sentences.en: But later, I don't think that's him going into the actual stalks.
sentences.zh: 但后来，我觉得冲进玉米秆里的那个人不是他。

sentences.en: I was so curious.

sentences.en: And Dwight starts yelling everyone's name as they arrive.
sentences.zh: 德怀特开始在客人们到达时大声喊出每个人的名字。

sentences.en: Jim has a talking head that says,
sentences.zh: 吉姆有个采访镜头说，

sentences.zh: 大声宣布客人的到来是礼仪的最高境界。

sentences.en: The more volume, the more honor bestowed.
sentences.zh: 声音越大，给予的荣誉就越高。

sentences.en: He's written this in his book, lady.
sentences.zh: 他把这些都写在他的书里了，女士。

sentences.en: This is part of his book and Dwight is following the rules.
sentences.zh: 这是他书中的一部分，而德怀特正在遵守规则。

sentences.en: You might have noticed that when Jim and Pam arrive,
sentences.zh: 你们可能注意到了，当吉姆和帕姆到达时，

sentences.zh: 他们被介绍为帕梅拉·詹姆斯和P.P.

sentences.en: Halpert.
sentences.zh: 哈珀特。

sentences.en: This was a callback that was improvised by Rain.
sentences.zh: 这是一个由雷恩即兴发挥的梗。

sentences.en: In the script, it simply said that he mumbles the baby's name.
sentences.zh: 剧本里只是简单写着他嘟囔了婴儿的名字。

sentences.en: So he would have said, James, Pamela, and P.P.
sentences.zh: 所以他本该说的是，詹姆斯、帕梅拉和P.P.

sentences.en: Halpert.
sentences.zh: 哈珀特。

sentences.en: But if you remember, Dwight called their daughter pee-pee in search committee,
sentences.zh: 但如果你们还记得，德怀特在《搜寻委员会》那一集里管他们的女儿叫“尿尿（pee-pee）”，

sentences.zh: 而雷恩·威尔森又把这个梗接上了。

sentences.en: Nice, Rainn.
sentences.zh: 干得好，雷恩。

sentences.en: Well, Oscar's annoyed by Andy's hovering, and Andy says to Oscar,
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡对安迪的徘徊感到恼火，安迪对奥斯卡说，

sentences.zh: 我希望一切都好好的。

sentences.en: That okay with you, Mabel?
sentences.zh: 你没意见吧，梅布尔？

sentences.zh: 梅布尔，梅布尔，如果你能做到，就把你的手肘从桌子上拿开。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.zh: 这让我很好奇。

sentences.en: Were there other Andy etiquette sayings in the shooting draft?

sentences.zh: 珍娜，还真有。

sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.zh: 这一段在删减片段里。

sentences.en: Kevin is taking way too many appetizers, and Andy walks up to him and says,
sentences.zh: 凯文拿了太多的开胃菜，安迪走过去对他说，

sentences.en: Kevin, this totally reminds me of this really lame, useful saying I learned as a kid.
sentences.zh: 凯文，这完全让我想起了我小时候学过的一句很烂但很有用的格言。

sentences.en: What's the difference between hors d'oeuvres and the animals on Noah's Ark?
sentences.zh: 开胃菜和诺亚方舟上的动物有什么区别？

sentences.zh: 对于开胃菜，我们一次只拿一个。

sentences.en: Oh, amazing.
sentences.zh: 哦，太棒了。

sentences.en: So many rules in Andy's life.
sentences.zh: 安迪的生活里有太多规矩了。

sentences.en: Well, guess what?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: The people Andy has been waiting for have arrived.
sentences.zh: 安迪一直在等的人到了。

sentences.en: Dwight very loudly announces the arrival of Walter and Ellen Bernard.
sentences.zh: 德怀特非常大声地宣布了沃尔特和艾伦·伯纳德的到来。

sentences.en: When Rain is Dwight yelled their names, I thought the actress that played Ellen's reaction was so great.
sentences.zh: 当雷恩饰演的德怀特大喊他们的名字时，我觉得饰演艾伦的那位女演员的反应太棒了。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So thrown off.
sentences.zh: 完全被搞懵了。

sentences.en: Like, what is happening?
sentences.zh: 就像是，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Dee Wallace is who played Andy's mom, Ellen.
sentences.zh: 迪·华莱士饰演了安迪的妈妈艾伦。

sentences.en: Steve Burgess worked with her before and was so excited to have her back on the show.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯以前和她合作过，非常高兴能让她回到剧组。

sentences.en: Angela, I know Dee, not personally, but because she has starred in so many classic horror filMs.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我认识迪，不是私下认识，是因为她主演过太多经典恐怖片了。

sentences.en: She is like a horror queen.
sentences.zh: 她简直是恐怖片女王。

sentences.en: I love her.
sentences.zh: 我爱死她了。

sentences.en: Oh, I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不知道。

sentences.en: She was in the original 1977 The Hills Have Eyes.
sentences.zh: 她出演了1977年的原版《隔山有眼》。

sentences.en: She was in The Howling, Cujo, Critters, Halloween, Death House.
sentences.zh: 她还演过《破胆三次》、《狂犬惊魂》、《魔精》、《月光光心慌慌》、《死亡屋》。

sentences.en: She is probably most famous for playing the mom in E.T.
sentences.zh: 她最出名的角色大概是《E.T.外星人》里的妈妈。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's how I know Dee.
sentences.zh: 我就是通过这些认识迪的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: And also Cujo.
sentences.zh: 还有《狂犬惊魂》。

sentences.en: I remember Cujo scared the crap out of me.
sentences.zh: 我记得《狂犬惊魂》把我吓得半死。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She said in an interview with Entertainment Tonight that she absolutely loves doing horror roles.
sentences.zh: 她在接受《娱乐今晚》采访时说，她非常喜欢演恐怖片角色。

sentences.en: And this was, I thought, really funny.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这一点特别有趣。

sentences.en: She said that if she had to have a career, like, just in comedy or something, it would just be so boring.
sentences.zh: 她说如果她的职业生涯只能演喜剧之类的，那会非常无聊。

sentences.en: Which is so funny because she is so good in this episode.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为她在这一集里的表现太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Everything about her is so subtle, and I couldn't take my eyes off her.
sentences.zh: 她的一切都处理得非常细腻，我目不转睛。

sentences.en: I thought she was fantastic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她演得太好了。

sentences.en: And then Stephen Collins is who played Walter Sr.
sentences.zh: 还有饰演老沃尔特的斯蒂芬·柯林斯。

sentences.en: He is very famous for playing the dad on Seventh Heaven, which he was on for 11 seasons.
sentences.zh: 他因在《七重天》中饰演父亲而闻名，他在那部剧里演了11季。

sentences.en: I have never seen Seventh Heaven.
sentences.zh: 我从没看过《七重天》。

sentences.en: I had not either.
sentences.zh: 我也没看过。

sentences.en: I missed it.
sentences.zh: 我错过了。

sentences.en: But here is the thing.
sentences.zh: 但重点是。

sentences.en: I guess I need to say, you might be aware of some news that came out about Stephen in 2014.
sentences.zh: 我想我得说，你可能听说过2014年关于斯蒂芬的一些新闻。

sentences.en: I don't know how to say this delicately.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么委婉地说。

sentences.en: I know a lot of people listen to the podcast with their kids.
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人会和孩子一起听这个播客。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So let me just say that in 2014, Stephen came forward and admitted to some pretty disturbing behavior in his paSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我只想说，2014年，斯蒂芬主动承认了他过去一些相当令人不安的行为。

sentences.en: If you Google him, it's the very first thing that comes up.
sentences.zh: 如果你去谷歌搜索他，最先跳出来的就是这些。

sentences.en: I don't want to maybe get into too many details here, but I did just want to mention that.
sentences.zh: 我不想在这里深入讨论细节，但我确实想提一下。

sentences.en: It was long after we had filmed with him.
sentences.zh: 那是在我们和他拍完戏很久之后的事了。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's upsetting.
sentences.zh: 但确实，这很令人难过。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'll leave it at that.
sentences.zh: 我就说到这儿吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We also, Angela, got a fan mail flurry of people writing in to point out that these are not the people we met at Toby's Going Away Party.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们还收到了一大堆粉丝来信，指出这些人并不是我们在托比欢送会上见到的那些人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When Andy proposes to Angela.
sentences.zh: 就是安迪向安吉拉求婚的时候。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It cuts to his parents and they are not the same actors.
sentences.zh: 镜头切到他父母时，演员换人了。

sentences.en: They also do not have the same names.
sentences.zh: 他们的名字也不一样了。

sentences.en: They are introduced as Ellen and Andrew Bernard, not Ellen and Walter Bernard.
sentences.zh: 他们被介绍为艾伦和安德鲁·伯纳德，而不是艾伦和沃尔特·伯纳德。

sentences.en: Now, you know, we have the show Bible where you have everyone's character and their history and their origin story.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有剧集设定集，里面记录了每个角色的背景和起源故事。

sentences.en: How did this happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么回事呢？

sentences.en: Well, after we did Goodbye, Toby, we had this very funny joke in a later episode where Andy says that his original name was Walter, that he was named after his dad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在拍完《再见，托比》之后，我们在后面的一集里加了个很有趣的梗，安迪说他原本叫沃尔特，是随他父亲的名字。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But then later when his younger brother was born, they renamed him Andy and then called his little brother Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 但后来他弟弟出生时，他们把他改名叫安迪，然后叫他弟弟小沃尔特。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So that was a joke that kind of went against that Goodbye, Toby moment, but it was so funny.
sentences.zh: 所以那个笑话有点违背了《再见，托比》里的设定，但真的太好笑了。

sentences.en: Sometimes when something was really funny to them, they would just go against the show Bible.
sentences.zh: 有时候，如果某个点子对他们来说特别好笑，他们就会无视设定集。

sentences.en: They were like, comedy first, show Bible later.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得喜剧优先，设定集靠后。

sentences.en: But I want to share a very interesting fan theory sent in by Eva S.
sentences.zh: 但我想要分享一个由来自伊利诺伊州奥罗拉的伊娃·S发来的非常有趣的粉丝理论。

sentences.en: from Aurora, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 来自伊利诺伊州奥罗拉。

sentences.en: I absolutely adored it.
sentences.zh: 我简直太喜欢这个理论了。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Eva says,
sentences.zh: 伊娃说，

sentences.en: And this is why he's so attached to his gam-gam, who we will meet later.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他那么依恋他的奶奶，我们之后会见到她。

sentences.en: When Andy was still a kid, his father had an affair with his secretary, as noted in Secretary's Day.
sentences.zh: 安迪小时候，他父亲曾与秘书有过一段婚外情，这在《秘书节》那一集中提到过。

sentences.en: Separating from Ellen and setting up a separate household with the secretary and her kids.
sentences.zh: 父亲与艾伦分居，并与秘书及其孩子们另组了家庭。

sentences.en: Even though Walter and the secretary were never officially married, this is who Andy means when he says, quote,
sentences.zh: 尽管沃尔特和那位秘书从未正式结婚，但安迪说那句话时指的就是他们，引用如下：

sentences.en: If it wasn't for secretaries, I wouldn't have a stepmom.
sentences.zh: 如果不是因为秘书，我就不会有继母了。

sentences.en: Andy got attached to her and her kids.
sentences.zh: 安迪和她以及她的孩子们产生了深厚的感情。

sentences.en: Even years later, he will refer to them as his brothers and sister.
sentences.zh: 即使多年以后，他仍会称呼他们为他的兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: And this is why he says he's wearing his sister's old field hockey skirt in St. Patrick's Day.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他在《圣帕特里克节》里说他穿着他姐姐旧的曲棍球裙。

sentences.en: And why he talks about doing puzzles with his brothers, plural, when we're out sailing in PDA.
sentences.zh: 也是为什么我们在《公开示爱》那集去航海时，他会说和他的兄弟们（复数）一起玩拼图。

sentences.en: Eva goes on.
sentences.zh: 伊娃继续说道。

sentences.en: Walter Sr.
sentences.zh: 老沃尔特

sentences.en: and Ellen end up going to the Breakers in Newport, Connecticut, where they decide not to get divorced.
sentences.zh: 和艾伦最终去了康涅狄格州纽波特的布雷克斯酒店，在那里他们决定不离婚。

sentences.en: Remember, that was from weight loss.
sentences.zh: 记住，那是减肥带来的结果。

sentences.en: So Walter Sr.
sentences.zh: 所以老沃尔特

sentences.en: broke up with the secretary, putting an end to Andy's stepfamily, but they stayed in his heart.
sentences.zh: 与秘书分手了，结束了安迪的继亲家庭，但他们依然留在他的心里。

sentences.en: That's why he still thinks of them as his real brothers and sister.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他仍然把他们当作自己真正的兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: But why did we see Andrew and Ellen Bernard at Toby's going away party?
sentences.zh: 但为什么我们在托比的欢送会上看到了安德鲁和艾伦·伯纳德？

sentences.en: Because Andy, who needs to make himself look good, actually hired two community theater performers to pose at his parents
sentences.zh: 因为安迪为了让自己看起来体面，雇了两名社区剧院的演员来扮演他的父母，

sentences.en: and act proud of him to impress his co-workers and Angela.
sentences.zh: 并假装为他感到骄傲，以此给他的同事和安吉拉留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: And then he named his pretend father, Andrew, so that he could be his father's namesake at laSt.
sentences.zh: 然后他给假父亲取名安德鲁，这样他终于可以成为父亲的同名者了。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: So those are all of her theories that bring together all of these inconsistencies.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是她将所有这些前后矛盾之处串联起来的理论。

sentences.en: Eva, I think you knocked it out of the park.
sentences.zh: 伊娃，我觉得你分析得太精彩了。

sentences.en: That all made it make sense for me.
sentences.zh: 这让我一切都想通了。

sentences.en: Eva, you're doing our writers a great service.
sentences.zh: 伊娃，你为我们的编剧帮了大忙。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm, you are.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼，确实如此。

sentences.en: By tying together all of those loose ends, I thought it was fantastic.
sentences.zh: 把所有这些零散的线索串联起来，我觉得太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to find out that Andy's parents don't have much time to be at the garden party
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们将会发现安迪的父母在花园派对上待的时间并不多，

sentences.zh: 因为他们买了剧院票，要和安迪随后出现的兄弟一起去看《点球成金》。

sentences.zh: 他的兄弟伯纳德出席了。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: That was a shock.
sentences.zh: 那真是个惊喜。

sentences.zh: 我们没听到有人宣布他到场。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.zh: 我想我们该休息一下了，因为派对上接下来要发生大事了。

sentences.en: Yes, now that Walter Jr.
sentences.zh: 是的，现在小沃尔特

sentences.en: has arrived, things are going to get interesting.
sentences.zh: 已经到了，事情要变得有趣了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We are back, and one of my favorite moments in this whole episode happens.
sentences.zh: 我们回来了，这一集中我最喜欢的时刻之一即将发生。

sentences.en: A crow is going to fly and steal Erin's hat off of her head.
sentences.zh: 一只乌鸦飞过来，从艾琳头上抢走了她的帽子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Andy is talking to Cece, and his dad comes in and just really just belittles him just horribly.
sentences.zh: 安迪正在和西西说话，他爸爸进来了，对他进行了极其恶劣的贬低。

sentences.en: And the whole time it's over the baby monitor, we find out that Oscar and Daryl and Pam and Jim and Aaron have overheard the whole conversation.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都通过婴儿监视器传了出去，我们发现奥斯卡、达里尔、帕姆、吉姆和亚伦听到了整个谈话过程。

sentences.en: He's told him he's not proud of him, that he's the manager of a rinky dink paper company in Scranton.
sentences.zh: 他告诉安迪他不为他感到骄傲，说他只是斯克兰顿一家破烂造纸公司的经理。

sentences.en: Just as horrible.
sentences.zh: 简直太可怕了。

sentences.en: And then his parents leave.
sentences.zh: 然后他的父母就离开了。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: There is no hug.
sentences.zh: 没有拥抱。

sentences.en: There's no, we're proud of you anyway.
sentences.zh: 没有那种“无论如何我们都为你骄傲”的话。

sentences.en: There's nothing positive.
sentences.zh: 没有任何积极的东西。

sentences.en: I did love the parents' talking head because I absolutely loved it when Dee Wallace said the sandwiches were dry.
sentences.zh: 我确实很喜欢他父母的采访片段，因为当迪·华莱士说三明治太干的时候，我简直太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I really loved it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: It was a very, like, parents' moment.
sentences.zh: 那非常有那种……父母的感觉。

sentences.en: Like, especially if you've planned your wedding, there's always some aunt and uncle or someone that has a comment that's like, well, I liked everything, but, you know,
sentences.zh: 比如，特别是如果你筹划过婚礼，总会有那么一两个叔叔阿姨或者什么人会发表意见，说什么，嗯，我什么都挺喜欢的，但是，你知道，

sentences.en: the bread was hard.
sentences.zh: 面包太硬了。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Then we have what I think is a little bit of a redemption moment for Andy.
sentences.zh: 接下来是安迪的一个救赎时刻，我是这么认为的。

sentences.en: Everyone is hanging out.
sentences.zh: 大家都在一起闲逛。

sentences.en: It's very casual now.
sentences.zh: 现在气氛非常随意。

sentences.en: Daryl is working the grill.
sentences.zh: 达里尔在烤架旁忙活。

sentences.en: Oscar tosses the nard dog, a cold one, and Andy sits down on a picnic blanket, and it feels warm and cozy and so friendly.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡扔给“纳德狗”一瓶冰镇啤酒，安迪坐在野餐垫上，感觉既温暖舒适又非常友好。

sentences.en: And boy, did Andy need this at the end of this day.
sentences.zh: 天哪，安迪在这一天结束时太需要这个了。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: We're going to have a final moment from Dwight as well, a final performance.
sentences.zh: 我们还要看德怀特最后的时刻，一场最后的表演。

sentences.en: It is a torch dance, a fire dance with the staff.
sentences.zh: 那是一场火炬舞，一场拿着棍棒的火舞。

sentences.en: This was, of course, from James Trickington's book about closing ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 这当然是出自詹姆斯·特里金顿关于闭幕式的书里。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: We had a fan question from Rebecca G.
sentences.zh: 我们收到一个来自德克萨斯州丽贝卡·G的粉丝提问，

sentences.en: in Texas who said, how long did it take for Rainn Wilson to learn the dance at the end of the episode?
sentences.zh: 她问，雷恩·威尔森学这一集结尾的舞蹈花了多久？

sentences.en: And Ryan S.
sentences.zh: 还有来自马萨诸塞州的瑞安·S，

sentences.en: from Massachusetts would like to know how many safety meetings were there about the use of fire in the closing ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 想知道关于闭幕式使用火的环节开了多少次安全会议。

sentences.en: Steve Burgess said that those dancers were an actual fire dance group.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·伯吉斯说那些舞者是专业的火舞团。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And that Marianne Kellogg was our choreographer.
sentences.zh: 而且玛丽安·凯洛格是我们的编舞。

sentences.en: He said Rainn Wilson learned that choreography and worked with the fire dancers for a couple of hours earlier that morning in order to do that scene.
sentences.zh: 他说雷恩·威尔森那天早上提前几个小时学会了编舞，并与火舞者们进行了排练，才完成了那个场景。

sentences.en: And as far as safety, Steve Burgess said we had a lot of safety meetings all the time.
sentences.zh: 至于安全方面，史蒂夫·伯吉斯说我们一直都在开很多安全会议。

sentences.en: We had a big one first thing in the morning where we talked all about the day.
sentences.zh: 我们一大早就在开一个大型会议，讨论全天的安排。

sentences.en: I believe he reiterated the rattlesnakes, he reiterated the bees, he told us to hydrate, and he mentioned that later in the day we would have fire.
sentences.zh: 我相信他重申了响尾蛇的事，重申了蜜蜂的事，告诉我们要补充水分，还提到当天晚些时候会有火。

sentences.en: I remember our morning safety meeting and I remember them introducing us to our snake wrangler.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们的早间安全会议，也记得他们把驯蛇师介绍给我们认识。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yes, I remember it because I'll never forget, you know, if you get bit by a rattlesnake,
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得，因为我永远不会忘记，你知道，如果你被响尾蛇咬了，

sentences.en: you are not supposed to run because that makes the venom move more quickly through your system.
sentences.zh: 你不应该奔跑，因为那会让毒液在你的身体里扩散得更快。

sentences.en: You're not supposed to have a person who has been bit by a rattlesnake move themselves out of the area.
sentences.zh: 你不应该让被响尾蛇咬伤的人自己离开现场。

sentences.en: Yeah, you are supposed to get someone to carry them out.
sentences.zh: 没错，你应该找人把他们抬出去。

sentences.en: And that was the whole thing, that it was like you're supposed to scream for help so that you can be carried out of the area.
sentences.zh: 重点就在这儿，你应该大声呼救，这样才能被抬离现场。

sentences.en: I just remember the guy had these really tall boots on.
sentences.zh: 我只记得那个人穿着那种特别高的靴子。

sentences.en: And you and I were walking around in little high heels or flats and I was like, should we all have the tall boots?
sentences.zh: 而你和我穿着小高跟鞋或平底鞋走来走去，我就想，我们是不是都该穿那种高靴子？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Where are the boots?
sentences.zh: 靴子在哪儿呢？

sentences.en: I want some boots.
sentences.zh: 我也想要双靴子。

sentences.en: Steve said we also fireproofed all of the wardrobe for the fire dancers.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫说我们还对火舞者的所有服装进行了防火处理。

sentences.en: And we had another safety meeting right before the fire dance started.
sentences.zh: 而且在火舞开始前，我们又开了一次安全会议。

sentences.en: And that's how it all went down.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.en: Before our rewatch is done of the office, I really want Kelly Cantley to come on and I want her to do a full safety meeting on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 在我们的《办公室》重温结束之前，我真的想请凯莉·坎特利来，我想让她在播客上做一次完整的安全会议。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对没问题。

sentences.en: It has to happen.
sentences.zh: 一定要实现。

sentences.en: This episode ends with a tag.
sentences.zh: 这一集以一个彩蛋结束。

sentences.en: It is Jim pranking Dwight.
sentences.zh: 是吉姆捉弄德怀特。

sentences.en: This prank made more sense to me, okay?
sentences.zh: 这个恶作剧我能看懂，好吗？

sentences.en: He's just going to enter the party over and over so that Dwight is constantly having to say,
sentences.zh: 他就是不断地进入派对现场，搞得德怀特不得不一直说，

sentences.en: Jim Halpert.
sentences.zh: 吉姆·哈珀特。

sentences.en: And he's like asking him questions like, who's the best salesman in the branch?
sentences.zh: 然后他问他一些问题，比如，分部最好的销售员是谁？

sentences.en: And then he exits and he comes back in, Jim Halpert.
sentences.zh: 接着他走出去，又走进来，吉姆·哈珀特。

sentences.en: And he just does this over and over.
sentences.zh: 他就是这样一遍又一遍地做。

sentences.en: I loved this whole bit of Rain announcing everyone and shouting as Dwight.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢雷恩宣布每个人的名字并模仿德怀特大喊大叫的那一段。

sentences.en: I thought it was a fun way to end the episode.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是结束这一集的一种有趣方式。

sentences.en: I want to say that I thought that this garden party with all of these weird elements was actually quite charming and interesting.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我觉得这场包含各种奇怪元素的花园派对其实相当迷人且有趣。

sentences.en: And like Robert California, I would be interested in having that party.
sentences.zh: 而且就像罗伯特·加利福尼亚一样，我也很有兴趣举办那样的派对。

sentences.en: Forget the beats.
sentences.zh: 忘了那些节拍吧。

sentences.en: Focus on parties minus the goats.
sentences.zh: 专注于派对，去掉山羊。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, there you have it, everybody.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，以上就是全部内容了。

sentences.en: That was garden party.
sentences.zh: 这就是《花园派对》那一集。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Thank you so much to Josh Groban for stopping by.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢乔什·格罗班能来做客。

sentences.en: What an absolute delight.
sentences.zh: 真是太令人愉快了。

sentences.en: And thank you to Steve Burgess for all his great insider info.
sentences.zh: 也感谢史蒂夫·伯吉斯提供的所有精彩内幕信息。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And next week we will be back with Spooked.
sentences.zh: 下周我们将回归，讨论《惊吓》那一集。

sentences.en: Oh, that's a Halloween episode.
sentences.zh: 哦，那是万圣节特辑。

sentences.en: Yum.
sentences.zh: 棒极了。

sentences.en: Halloween in June.
sentences.zh: 六月的万圣节。

sentences.en: Bye, you guys.
sentences.zh: 再见，大家。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。
